criteria.notes: Exhibition welcome board: museum name, exhibition title, gallery pointer, run dates and a single feature image, all present across every scenario.
Retains the Bauhaus colour-block concept: flat primary fields, hard panel edges, no gradients or shadows.
Reads as an exhibition poster rather than a dashboard; asymmetric panel grid with one dominant display face.
Auto-fit now reaches its intended size instead of the 64px floor, so the exhibition title fills its panel and is legible at distance viewing.
Alternate-colour scenario keeps white-on-dark and black-on-mint within readable contrast; the default primaries carry strong separation.
The long-title scenario wraps to five lines and scales down without ellipsis or clipping; body copy wraps inside its panel.
Panels tile the full canvas with no accidental gaps; the minimal scenario intentionally empties the gallery panel rather than leaving a defect.
Feature image renders inside the circular mask; broken-image and transparent-background scenarios both degrade to a clean placeholder.
Flat primary colour blocking is distinct from the dark card-and-accent language used by the dashboard examples.
